title: A Conversation with Paul Graham - Moderated by Geoff Ralston
summary: Y Combinator's Geoff Ralston interviews Paul Graham about startups and founders in a Startup School conversation. It touches on Viaweb, Robert Morris and what makes founders effective.
why: HN mostly cites it for specific Graham remarks, such as advice to find a paying customer and a recent interview about Viaweb.

quote.text: Here is a (recent) very interesting interview with PG, among others, talking about Viaweb.
